name: Engineering Scholar Study
body:
Associated Skill Knowledge (engineering) (Int)

Basic Study Ability
Jury-Rig (Ex)

You gain Field Repair as a bonus feat, even if you do not meet the feat’s prerequisites. In addition, you can make temporary repairs to broken items on the fly. Jury-rigging a broken object requires a Knowledge (engineering) check with a DC equal to the Disable Device DC to disable a device of the same complexity (if applicable), or the DC to craft a new item of the same type (otherwise). The time required is the same amount of time as a Disable Device check for a device of the same complexity (if applicable) or one full round (otherwise). If the check is successful, the object is relieved of the broken condition for up to 5 minutes. If a jury-rigged object takes any damage in the interim, it regains the broken condition. A jury-rigged object cannot benefit from this ability more than once until it has been repaired.

Associated Technique
Sundering Technique (Ex)

You gain a +1 bonus to your CMB on any combat maneuver check made to sunder an item wielded by a target you have studied with this ability, and you never provoke attacks of opportunity while using a sunder combat maneuver against that target. At 3rd level and every 3 levels thereafter, this bonus increases by 1, to a maximum of +7 at 18th level. Any time you destroy a magic item with a sunder maneuver, you can choose to make it a temporary effect, rendering the item completely unusable for 24 hours until its magic returns.

Advanced Study Abilities
Demolition (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Jury-Rig study ability, scholar level 5th.

You have developed a knack for understanding how the structural integrity of an object can be compromised. You always ignore a number of points of an object’s hardness equal to 1/2 your ranks in Knowledge (engineering). In addition, if an object is unattended, you deal bonus precision damage to it equal to 1d8 per 4 ranks that you have in Knowledge (engineering), to a maximum of +5d8 precision damage at 20 ranks. (This damage is not multiplied on a critical hit.) If you have the Improved Sunder feat, you can also deal this precision damage to creatures of the construct type if they are caught flat-footed, or to attended objects (using a sunder maneuver) when their bearers are flat-footed.

Eye for Detail (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Jury-Rig study ability, scholar level 2nd.

Disable Device becomes a class skill for you, and you can use inspiration with that skill for free. You can also disarm magical traps with that skill, as per the rogue’s trapfinding class feature.

Special: This counts as having the trapfinding ability for the purpose of meeting prerequisites.

Terrain Tactics (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Eye for Detail study ability, Knowledge (engineering) 5 ranks, scholar level 5th.

If you study an area for at least 1 minute, you can expend one point of inspiration to develop tactics for that area. (If you have the favored terrain class feature or the terrain mastery rogue talent, and this area is one of your chosen terrains, you instead need to study the area for only 1 round before using this ability.) During this time, you take note of the lay of the land and any natural advantages and disadvantages it offers. You then designate one 5-foot square for every rank of Knowledge (engineering) you possess. For the next 24 hours, you are treated as having concealment (20% miss chance) and cannot be flanked while standing in one of the designated squares. (If you occupy more than one square, you gain this benefit if you occupy at least one such square.) True seeing and similar abilities (but not see invisibility) negate the concealment, but you still cannot be flanked. So long as you have the concealment against an opponent, you can use a Knowledge (engineering) check to make a Stealth check while in this area. If you are at least a 16th level scholar with 16 ranks in Knowledge (engineering), you gain the hide in plain sight ability (as the ranger class feature) while in this area. You can have only one area active for your terrain tactics ability at a given time; establishing a new active area ends the previous one.

Tinker’s Touch (Sp)

Prerequisite(s): Jury-Rig study ability, scholar level 3rd.

You can use mending at will as a spell-like ability by expending 1 point of inspiration.

When you reach 8 ranks in Knowledge (engineering), you can expend 1 point of inspiration to use crafter’s fortune. When you reach 13 ranks, you can expend 2 points of inspiration to use make whole. When you reach 18 ranks, you can expend 3 points of inspiration to use greater make whole. The range for all of these abilities is touch, and you use your ranks in Knowledge (engineering) as your caster level.
